title: Insha ya Maelekezo (Theme 14: Matumizi ya pesa)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child plans insha ya maelekezo before writing: the parts in order, then one idea at a time, then checks it against the type.

floor.prerequisite: Writes a correct sentence with a capital letter and a kikomo.
floor.question: Andika sentensi moja kuhusu shule yako.

representations: a model text with its parts labelled
steps: Read the title and say the type.
Check against the checklist and correct.
contexts: jinsi ya kufungua akaunti ya akiba
a letter or story for a family member

board.do: Jinsi ya Kufungua Akaunti ya Akiba

board.say: Insha hii ni ya aina gani, na itakuwa na sehemu zipi?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child fills the three-box plan for "Jinsi ya Kufungua Akaunti ya Akiba".

listen_for: hatua ya kwanza moja kwa moja
misconceptions.repair: Anza kwa lengo na vifaa vinavyohitajika.

misconceptions.ask: Sentensi hii inamwelekeza msomaji au inasimulia?
misconceptions.repair: Maelekezo hutumia amri au hali ya kuagiza: chukua, weka.

listen_for: weka pesa ya kwanza, jaza fomu, andaa kitambulisho, chagua benki au SACCO
misconceptions.ask: Unaweza kufanya hatua hii kabla ya ile?
misconceptions.repair: Fuata mpangilio wa hatua na utumie maneno ya mpangilio.

checks.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya maelekezo kuhusu "Jinsi ya Kufungua Akaunti ya Akiba"?
Insha ya maelekezo ina sehemu zipi?
